array.string:
REPO="$HOME/mems26/mems26_web_git" LOG="/tmp/parity.log" exec >> "$LOG" 2>&1 echo "════ parity $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z') ════"
DOW=$(date +%w) if [ "$DOW" = "0" ] || [ "$DOW" = "6" ]; then echo "weekend — skipping" exit 0 fi
cd "$REPO" || exit 1 set -a; [ -f .env ] && source .env; set +a
.venv/bin/python3 scripts/parity_report.py --json 2>&1
# commit+push the report DLREPO="$HOME/Downloads/mems26_web_git" if [ -d "$DLREPO/.git" ]; then # copy report to the push-capable repo DATE=$(TZ=America/New_York date +%Y-%m-%d) MACHINE="${MACHINE_TAG:-mac2}" SRC="$REPO/docs/reports/PARITY_${MACHINE}_${DATE}.md" mkdir -p "$DLREPO/docs/reports" [ -f "$SRC" ] && cp "$SRC" "$DLREPO/docs/reports/" cd "$DLREPO" git add "docs/reports/PARITY_${MACHINE}_${DATE}.md" 2>/dev/null git commit -m "cc-imac: parity report ${DATE} (auto)" 2>/dev/null git push github-mems26:michaelbarg/mems26-web.git stabilize/mems26-local-truth-2026-05-16 2>/dev/null || true fi
echo "════ done ════"
